title: Halo Hacker asset record
description: One in-scope asset (an observation, never agent-authored graph structure). Six types with per-type identity keys; the program computes parentage and dedupe (tools/assets.py), agents only submit observations. Inspired by ARTEX's asset layer (AGPL) — reimplemented, no code shared. Identity is deliberately loose: dedupe keys are derived per type, so the same surface seen twice collapses to one record.

asset_id.description: Stable id derived from type+identity by the store (not chosen by the agent).

identity.description: The dedupe key for this type. root_domain/subdomain: {domain}. ip: {ip}. service: {host, port, scheme}. endpoint: {method, url}. app: {name} or {bundle_id}.

parent_ref.description: asset_id of the containing asset, computed by the program (root_domain→subdomain→service→endpoint). Never set by the agent.

attributes.description: Enrichment observations: status_code, page_title, technologies[], open_ports[], content_length, favicon hash, etc. Free-form observations; dedupe never keys on these.

source.description: How the observation entered (mirrors the finding source vocabulary).
